## setKeyPolicy() function

Store (or replace) the governance policy attached to an API key.

The policy is validated before it is written, so an invalid document can never reach the database, and is encrypted at rest with the same derived key as the rest of the key metadata.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function setKeyPolicy(keyId: string, policy: GovernancePolicy, updatedAt?: Date): void
```
